WITH __kumo_keys__ AS (
  SELECT k.i - 1 AS __kumo_batch__, k.v.f0 AS __kumo_id__
  FROM unnest(from_json(?, '[{"f0":"BIGINT"}]'))
    WITH ORDINALITY AS k(v, i)
)
SELECT tmp.__kumo_batch__, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY tmp.__kumo_batch__) AS __kumo_matches__, "purchase_id", "customer_id", "item_id", "purchased_at", "store_code"
FROM __kumo_keys__ tmp
JOIN "purchases"
  ON "purchase_id" = tmp.__kumo_id__
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
  PARTITION BY tmp.__kumo_batch__
  ORDER BY "customer_id", "item_id", "purchase_id", "purchased_at", "store_code"
) = 1
